command:
git add docs && git commit -q -m "docs: correct the wait-ceiling claim in the bridge note (APRV-349)" -m "The note said the hook waits 55 seconds, which is true of the Claude
Code adapter and its 60-second harness timeout and not true of the
Codex hook entry, which is configured for a nine-minute gate wait
inside a ten-minute outer timeout. The point survives the correction
and is sharper for it: every hook answers inside a ceiling the harness
sets, the ceiling is what the retry grace exists to make survivable,
and the app-server has no ceiling at all rather than a wider one.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git push 2>&1 | tail -2
